question: From Table 3, what combined area percentage do the two unsaturated methyl esters (methyl linoleate and methyl oleate) make up?
rendered:
According to Table 3, the area percentages of methyl linoleate and methyl oleate are 20.51% and 27.81%, respectively. 

Combined area percentage of the two unsaturated methyl esters = 20.51 + 27.81 = 48.32%.
